title: Machine Safety
disclaimer: General guidance. The guarding and lockout needed for a particular machine comes from its risk assessment, the maker's manual and your site procedure. Standards and legal references marked verify must be checked against the current text.

hazard_types.label: In-running nip
hazard_types.text: Two parts moving towards each other (a belt and a roller, or two rollers) can draw in a hand or clothing.

hazard_types.label: Entanglement
hazard_types.text: Rotating shafts, chucks and tools can catch hair, gloves, sleeves or jewellery.

hazard_types.label: Shearing
hazard_types.text: Parts moving past each other like scissors (blade and table, ram and bed).

hazard_types.label: Crushing
hazard_types.text: A part moving toward a fixed part or another moving part, trapping the body.

hazard_types.label: Cutting or severing
hazard_types.text: Sharp edges, blades, saw teeth and abrasive wheels.

hazard_types.label: Ejection
hazard_types.text: Chips, broken tools, abrasive wheel fragments or workpieces thrown out of the machine.

hazard_types.label: Stored energy
hazard_types.text: Pressure, springs, gravity, flywheels or capacitors that can move parts after power is off.

guard_types.label: Fixed guard
guard_types.text: Fixed with screws or bolts: removable only with tools. Use where access is rarely needed.

guard_types.label: Interlocked guard
guard_types.text: When opened, it stops the hazard. The machine cannot restart until it is closed again.

guard_types.label: Adjustable guard
guard_types.text: Adjusted to suit the work; must be set correctly each time.

guard_types.label: Distance guard
guard_types.text: A barrier that keeps hands out of reach by safe distance (see ISO 13857).

guard_types.label: Light curtain
guard_types.text: Sensing device that stops the machine when the beam is broken.

guard_types.label: Two-hand control
guard_types.text: Both hands must press controls together so neither hand can be in the danger zone.

guard_types.label: Hold-to-run / enabling device
guard_types.text: Movement only while the control is held; used for setting and teach modes.

guard_types.label: Emergency stop
guard_types.text: Red mushroom button on a yellow background; latched; it must stop the hazard quickly and not be used as a normal stop.

machines.name: Lathe (turning machine)
hazards: Entanglement in the rotating chuck and workpiece
nip_points: Bar stock sticking out of the headstock
guarding: Chuck guard (interlocked where the chuck is accessible)
Bar-stock tube or guard at the rear
Chip shield / splash guard
Guards fitted on belts and gears
controls: Remove the chuck key before starting (key-retaining device)
Brake or controlled stop on the spindle
No gloves, loose sleeves or jewellery; tie back hair
Use a brush or hook for swarf, never hands
pre_start_checks: Guards in place and interlocks working
Chuck is secure and the key is removed
Work area clear; coolant level OK
machines.loto_notes: Isolate the main switch and lock; wait for the spindle to stop fully; release any clamped work before cleaning.

machines.name: Milling machine
guarding: Cutter guard or enclosure with interlock
Chip guard
Fixed guards on belts and gears
controls: Stop the spindle before measuring or changing work
Use clamps correctly and keep the work secure
Tool changes only with the spindle locked off
machines.loto_notes: Lock off power; support the head or table if it can drop; remove the cutter before cleaning.

machines.name: Drill press
hazards: Entanglement in the drill bit and chuck
Flying work that is not clamped
guarding: Adjustable chuck guard
Guard on the belt and pulleys
controls: Clamp the workpiece; never hold it by hand
Chuck key removed before starting
No gloves or loose clothing
machines.loto_notes: Lock off the power before changing the bit or belts.

machines.name: CNC machining center
hazards: Contact with moving axes or tool changer
guarding: Fully enclosed guarding with interlocked doors
Door lock that stops motion until the spindle is stopped
Chip and coolant shields
controls: Do not defeat or bypass door interlocks
Spindle and axes stop before the door is opened
Set-up mode with reduced speed and hold-to-run control
machines.loto_notes: Isolate the power and stored energy (air, hydraulic); lock the main isolator before entering the enclosure.

machines.name: Mechanical power press
hazards: Crush or amputation at the die area
nip_points: Point of operation between the dies
guarding: Fixed enclosure or interlocked barrier guard
Light curtain with a safe stopping time
Two-hand control with anti-tie-down
Die guards
controls: Never reach into the die area while the press is live
Use hand tools to feed or remove small parts
Brake monitoring and stopping-time checks
Lock off before die setting
machines.loto_notes: Isolate the electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic energy; block the slide with die-safety blocks before work between the dies.

machines.name: Press brake
hazards: Crush of fingers or hands at the tool
Pinch of the sheet being lifted
nip_points: Point of operation between punch and die
guarding: Light curtain or laser guarding with muting
Foot pedal with a hold-to-run control
Rear fixed guards
controls: Never hold small parts near the tool; use fixtures or jigs
Stop the beam before reaching in
Use two people or mechanical aids for large sheets
pre_start_checks: Foot pedal in good condition and guarded
machines.loto_notes: Lock off power; block the ram if it could move; release hydraulic pressure before changing tools.

machines.name: Hydraulic press
guarding: Fixed or interlocked guards
Light curtain
Two-hand control
controls: Relief valve set correctly and sealed
Inspect hoses and fittings for leaks
Never use hands to find a hydraulic leak
machines.loto_notes: Release stored hydraulic pressure and lock the ram mechanically before maintenance.

machines.name: Injection molding machine
hazards: Burns from hot barrel and material
guarding: Interlocked front and rear gates
Mould-area guard
Barrel and nozzle guard
controls: Gates must stop clamp movement when opened
Do not bypass safety gates or switches
Wear heat-resistant gloves for hot material
machines.loto_notes: Isolate power and hydraulics, release pressure, lock the platens mechanically and allow the barrel to cool.

machines.name: Belt / roller conveyor
nip_points: In-running nip between belt and drum or roller
guarding: Fixed guards on drives and tail drum
Nip guards at all in-running points
Pull-cord emergency stop along the length
Guards to prevent walking on or under (crossovers)
controls: Never clear a jam or clean a running conveyor
Keep loose clothing and hair away
Interlock covers to stop the drive when opened
pre_start_checks: Pull-cord stop works along its length
machines.loto_notes: Lock off the drive and release belt tension or stored energy; prevent movement of loads on inclines.

machines.name: Bench grinder / angle grinder
nip_points: Gap between the wheel and the tool rest
guarding: Wheel guard enclosing most of the wheel
Adjustable work rest set close to the wheel (about 2 mm to 3 mm)
Tongue guard
controls: Use a wheel with the correct speed rating and check it by a ring test
Dress the wheel; do not use a cracked wheel
Hold the angle grinder with both hands and keep the guard on
pre_start_checks: Use PPE: eye, face and hearing protection
machines.loto_notes: Unplug or lock off; wait for the wheel to stop; never leave the machine to coast.

machines.name: Band saw / circular saw
guarding: Blade guard that adjusts to the stock
Fixed guards on the wheels and pulleys
Riving knife on circular saws
controls: Use push sticks
Keep the guard close to the work
Do not remove jammed material while running
pre_start_checks: Blade not damaged and correctly tensioned
machines.loto_notes: Lock off power; wait for the blade to stop; wear gloves only to handle a stopped blade.

machines.name: Guillotine / sheet metal shear
guarding: Fixed guard or finger guard at the front
Interlocked rear guard
Two-hand or foot control with guarding
controls: Keep hands outside the guard line
Use tools to push small pieces
Handle sheets with gloves rated for cuts
machines.loto_notes: Lock off power; block the blade or ram; release stored energy.

machines.name: Industrial robot cell
hazards: Crushed between the arm and fixed parts
nip_points: Gap between the arm and fixed structures
guarding: Perimeter fence with interlocked gates
Light curtain or area scanner at openings
Enabling device and reduced speed for teach mode
controls: Do not enter the cell unless the robot is stopped and locked off
Test the emergency stop and safe-limited speed regularly
Control access with a key or lock-off for maintenance
machines.loto_notes: Isolate the power and pneumatics, release stored energy, apply a personal lock and take the key into the cell.

machines.name: Air compressor
guarding: Fixed belt guard
Guard on hot pipes
controls: Safety valve is tested; do not alter the setting
Drain the receiver condensate regularly
Check the pressure vessel inspection date
pre_start_checks: Safety valve and pressure gauge OK
machines.loto_notes: Isolate power; vent and drain the receiver fully before opening any line.

machines.name: Packaging / wrapping machine
guarding: Interlocked guards on access doors
Fixed guards on drives
Light barrier at feed openings
controls: Stop the machine for jam clearance
Do not bypass interlocks
Allow sealing bars to cool before touching
machines.loto_notes: Isolate the electrical and pneumatic power; wait for heating elements to cool.

loto_steps.title: Prepare
loto_steps.text: Identify the machine and every energy source: electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, mechanical (springs, flywheels), gravity, thermal and chemical. Read the lockout procedure.

loto_steps.title: Notify
loto_steps.text: Tell the affected operators and the supervisor that the machine will be shut down and locked out.

loto_steps.title: Shut down
loto_steps.text: Stop the machine using the normal stopping procedure.
loto_steps.check: Machine has come to a complete stop.

loto_steps.title: Isolate
loto_steps.text: Operate the isolating devices (switches, valves, breakers) to cut every energy source.
loto_steps.check: Isolators are in the safe position.

loto_steps.title: Lock and tag
loto_steps.text: Apply your own personal lock and tag to each isolating point. Each person working on the machine adds their own lock.
loto_steps.check: Each lock is yours with your name on the tag.

loto_steps.title: Release stored energy
loto_steps.text: Bleed pressure, block or support raised parts, discharge capacitors, let hot parts cool and restrain spring tension.

loto_steps.title: Verify (try-out)
loto_steps.text: Test that the machine cannot start: try the normal start controls, check gauges and use a tested voltage tester where relevant. Then return the controls to off.
loto_steps.check: Isolation is proven before work starts.

loto_restore: Remove tools and check that everyone is clear of the machine.
Replace guards and check that safety devices work.
Remove locks and tags: each person removes only their own lock.
Tell the affected operators, then restart.
loto_rules: Only the person who applied a lock removes it.
One person, one lock; use a group lock box for team jobs.
Never bypass or remove another person's lock or tag.
Test before touch: prove the isolation works.
Contractors follow the same lockout procedure.
legal_references: India: Factories Act 1948, Section 21 (fencing of machinery) and Section 22 (work on or near machinery in motion) - verify the current text and state rules
USA: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 (control of hazardous energy), 1910.212 (general machine guarding), 1910.219 (power transmission)
International: ISO 12100 (risk assessment), ISO 14120 (guards), ISO 13857 (safety distances), ISO 13849-1 (control systems), ISO 13850 (emergency stop), IEC 60204-1 (electrical equipment of machines)
